headline: The walk pays rent
fortune: A ten-minute walk will untangle a thought that has been sitting in your head with its shoes on.

headline: A plan cancels itself
fortune: One dull plan will cancel itself, leaving you an unexpected hour. Spend at least seven minutes doing absolutely nothing.

headline: The snack finds you
fortune: On a tired afternoon, someone will hand you exactly the snack you were thinking about. This is what destiny studied for.

headline: The rain respects your timing
fortune: The first drops wait until you reach an awning. A hot cup appears nearby, as if the clouds planned refreshments.

headline: The last samosa chooses you
fortune: Just when the tray looks empty, one hot samosa appears. The person beside you insists you take it—and means it.

headline: Your song finds you
fortune: An old favorite plays on a tiring afternoon. You remember every word and forget at least half the worry.

headline: Past-you buys the chai
fortune: You find forgotten money in an old pocket—exactly enough for chai and something sweet. Past-you has impeccable timing.

headline: Someone remembers the small thing
fortune: Without asking, someone remembers how you like your tea. The cup is ordinary; the care is not.

headline: The slow line surprises everyone
fortune: The line you choose moves first for once. Please remain humble during this historic event.

headline: A street dog appoints you
fortune: A friendly dog walks beside you for half a lane, then leaves after confirming you are going the right way.

headline: Laughter calls after sunset
fortune: An old friend rings with no request and no bad news—only a story that makes your cheeks hurt from laughing.

headline: The best breeze finds your chair
fortune: On a warm afternoon, the only cool breeze chooses your corner. Everyone else will suspect favoritism.

headline: One extra sweet appears
fortune: Someone quietly saves the last peda for you. You offer to share; they wisely refuse your politeness.
